digest.component_or_area: S2 CLI parser and route registry foundation
propositions: A stdlib-only factory protocol and immutable route registry must be defined to describe routes and locate parsers without importing handlers or optional dependencies.
The registry must validate duplicate spellings, illegal aliases, retired collisions, contradictory policies, unknown capabilities, and malformed references deterministically.

Route records must hold lazy references to handlers and parser factories plus metadata (identity, alias, visibility, help, mount, confirmation, output, capability), and derive legacy policy-set exports with zero shadow-census delta.
Registry construction and route lookup must not import handlers or optional dependencies, enforced by subprocess-based import isolation tests.
Deterministic help output and parse error handling must be produced by a shared argparse customization with fixed width, UTF-8 LF output, and one trailing newline independent of terminal.
